lengthHint: Length in metres — type a value and press Enter
empty: Choose the wall tool, then click each corner. Double-click to finish.
calibrateHint: Click both ends of a distance you know.
knownLengthHint: The real length of the line you measured, in metres
noRooms: Close a loop of walls and the room appears here.
unnamed: {count} rooms have no type yet — those produce no BOQ lines.
lockedBy: {name} is editing this plan. You can look, but not change it.
conflict: Someone else saved this plan while you were drawing. Reload before you carry on.
restoreConfirm: Restore "{name}"? This replaces the drawing and clears the undo history.
exportEmpty: Draw something first — there is nothing to print yet.
doesNotFit: The plan does not fit this sheet at that scale. It will be clipped.

errors.WALL_TOO_SHORT: That wall is too short to keep. Draw at least 10 mm.
errors.WALL_INVALID_THICKNESS: Wall thickness must be greater than zero.
errors.WALL_INVALID_HEIGHT: Wall height must be greater than zero.
errors.OPENING_NEEDS_A_WALL: An opening has to sit on a wall. Click on one.
errors.OPENING_TOO_NARROW: That opening is too narrow. Make it at least 300 mm.
errors.OPENING_OUTSIDE_WALL: That opening would run off the end of its wall.
errors.OPENING_OVERLAPS: There is already an opening in that part of the wall.
errors.OPENING_INVALID_HEIGHT: Opening height must be greater than zero.
errors.OPENING_INVALID_SILL: A sill cannot sit below the floor.
errors.OPENING_WALL_MISMATCH: That opening belongs to a different wall.
errors.SECTION_TOO_SMALL: That section is too small. Make it at least 50 mm.
errors.SECTION_INVALID_HEIGHT: Height must be greater than zero.
errors.BEAM_TOO_SHORT: That beam is too short to keep. Draw at least 100 mm.
errors.BACKGROUND_EMPTY: That image has no pixels to place.
errors.BACKGROUND_INVALID_SCALE: The underlay scale must be greater than zero.
errors.CALIBRATION_NO_LENGTH: Pick two different points to calibrate against.
errors.CALIBRATION_INVALID_LENGTH: Enter the real length, greater than zero.
errors.PLAN_UNAVAILABLE: This plan could not be opened. Check your connection and try again.
errors.PLAN_LOCKED: Someone else is editing this plan right now.
errors.CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION: Someone else saved this plan first. Reload to see their version.
errors.REVISION_NAME_REQUIRED: Give the version a name you will recognise later.
errors.REVISION_NAME_TOO_LONG: That version name is too long.
errors.PLAN_ARCHIVED: This plan is archived and can no longer be edited.
errors.NETWORK: No connection to the server. Your work is still here — it just has not been saved.
